name: RA 11166
detail: The Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act (2018), implemented by government and PNAC, strengthens a rights-based response. The document highlights testing confidentiality, protection against discrimination, age-appropriate education, accessible ART, community prevention, and collaboration.

name: DOH National HIV, AIDS & STI Program
detail: The document describes confidential testing, free ART for people enrolled in the treatment program, safer-sex education, awareness campaigns, and expansion of PrEP and PEP access.

name: OPLAN PROPEL
detail: A DOH initiative described as expanding prevention, diagnosis, and treatment through stronger healthcare delivery, coordinated action, and community participation.

name: SHIP
detail: Sustained Health Initiatives of the Philippines supports community health, key populations, awareness, access to testing information, and dissemination of HIV surveillance resources.

name: Pilipinas Shell Foundation
detail: PSFI collaborates with agencies, NGOs, and local governments. The document lists Champion Community Centers, condoms and lubricants, PrEP/PEP awareness, outreach, and support for key populations.

name: The Red Whistle
detail: Creative campaigns, social media, educational materials, advocacy against discrimination, community collaborations, and encouragement to seek testing and treatment.

name: RAJAH Community Centre
focus: A safe space in Iloilo City
detail: Created by FPOP, RAJAH is described as a primary HIV clinic offering counselling, telemedicine, mobile clinics, PrEP, condoms, and psychosocial support.

name: AHF Philippines
detail: The source reports support for 27 healthcare sites, eight with combination prevention services, and partnerships with community groups, local governments, LoveYourself, and San Lazaro Hospital. These describe the source, not a live directory.
